purpose: The chromosome 19 counts the Species and assembly table of docs/cli/cache-species-runtime.md states for the --pubmed and --var_synonyms row: how many variants of the Ensembl release 116 mouse cache's chromosome 19 variation file carry a citation and how many a synonym.

commands.count: zcat all_vars.gz | awk -F'\t' '{ n++; if ($14 != ".") p++; if ($15 != ".") s++ } END { print n, p, s }'
commands.note: one tab-separated row per variant; column 14 is pubmed and column 15 var_synonyms in variation_cols, each `.` where the variant carries none
